items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: the captain, Captain John, he came there

ctx.x: I didn't know him. You never know that? He's in California.

He wasn't from here. I didn't forget where he was. But he'd come down there and stay at Goodwire. He was a learning type of printing. And Lewis used to come around us all the time. He was a professor. You know, he was a musician. And we played with him. I had the Marlene Creole jazz band. That's right there. And the bass player was the darkest one in the band. And we played on. You know what I told you that time? The old Apsom. It was named, let me see what was his name. I didn't call his name before. Hawkins.…
I'm asking who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band.
